dl-t15.description: Building access, elevator reservation, loading dock, and move-in timing rules for the target apartment building.
canonical_facts: service_address=1717 Harbor Ave, Unit references vary by listing
move_in_window_policy=Move-ins permitted Mon-Sat 9:00 AM-5:00 PM only
elevator_reservation_channel=Reserve via leasing office or resident portal
loading_dock_access=Loading dock entrance on Bay Street, code issued after lease execution
insurance_requirement=Certificate of renters insurance required before key release
pet_policy_building=Pets allowed subject to lease/community addendum

dl-t15.generation_prompt: Render a realistic 2-page apartment building instruction PDF titled 'Harbor Point Residences - Building Access & Move-In Instructions'. Include header with property logo, address '1717 Harbor Ave'. Body text should clearly state: move-ins allowed Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; no Sunday move-ins; freight/service elevator reservation required with minimum 48 hours notice; reservations handled by leasing office or resident portal; loading dock entrance on Bay Street; access code released only after lease execution; certificate of renters insurance required before key pickup; pets allowed subject to lease/community addendum. Add a footer referencing request DL-015 and customer Celeste Rowan. Make text crisp and machine-readable.

dl-t15.description: ID verification scan establishing the exact customer identity for the lease application.
canonical_facts: warning=Distinguishes customer from decoy similar-surname records such as DL-CUST-051
relevance=Needed for application submission and correct-entity verification
dl-t15.generation_prompt: Create a realistic single-page ID verification PDF scan for a customer named Celeste Rowan. It should resemble a mobile-uploaded verification summary with a thumbnail of a driver's license and extracted OCR fields. Include clear text fields: Full Name 'Celeste Rowan', DOB '1994-08-12', ID Type 'Driver License', State 'CA', License ending '4821', Mailing City 'Oakland'. Include verification status 'Passed' and reference 'Customer ID: DL-CUST-015'. Add a subtle note that the record was verified for request DL-015. Avoid extra sensitive details beyond the listed fields.

dl-t17.description: Physician referral for Imani Vale specifying diagnosis, PT recommendation, visit frequency, and referral validity constraints.
canonical_facts: diagnosis: left ankle grade II sprain with residual instability after home recovery
service_referred: outpatient physical therapy evaluation and treatment
allowed_modalities: supervised therapeutic exercise, proprioceptive/balance training, progressive strengthening
contraindications: no plyometrics, no running, no jump training for first 4 weeks
frequency: 2 visits per week for 4 weeks
special_note: guided recovery program acceptable if licensed physical therapist performs initial evaluation
special_note: patient available after 4:30 PM weekdays or Saturday mornings
dl-t17.generation_prompt: Render a realistic one-page physician referral PDF on orthopedic clinic letterhead for patient Imani Vale. Include header with clinic name 'Harbor Ridge Sports Medicine', address, phone, and fax. Title: 'Physical Therapy Referral'. Body should contain patient demographics with customer identifier DL-CUST-017, request reference DL-017, diagnosis 'Left ankle grade II sprain with residual instability after home recovery' and ICD-10 S93.402D, referral date 2025-02-03, expiration/valid through 2025-04-04. Include explicit order: 'Outpatient physical therapy evaluation and treatment, 2 visits/week x 4 weeks (8 visits total).' Include treatment guidance: supervised therapeutic exercise, proprioceptive/balance training, progressive strengthening. Include restrictions in bold: 'No plyometrics, running, or jump training for first 4 weeks.' Include note: 'Guided recovery program acceptable if licensed PT performs the initial evaluation.' Include scheduling note: 'Patient reports availability after 4:30 PM weekdays or Saturday mornings.' Include physician name Dr. Leena Shah, MD, NPI 1184926501, signature block with signed appearance. Ensure text is crisp and machine-readable.

dl-t17.description: Combined front-and-back insurance card image showing active plan identifiers, copay, specialist/PT limits, and prior authorization contact instructions.

prior_auth_rule: prior authorization not required for first 6 PT visits, required starting visit 7

dl-t17.generation_prompt: Create a realistic insurance card image laid out as front and back side-by-side in a single PNG. Front: insurer 'Meridian Health PPO', plan 'Silver Choice PPO', member name Imani Vale, member ID MVL48392017, group number GRP-77104, effective date 01/01/2025. Include a clean professional design with blue and gray palette and a small PPO badge. Back: readable benefit notes in card-style small print, but still legible. Include explicit lines: 'Specialist copay $35', 'Outpatient Physical Therapy: Covered, 20 visits per calendar year', 'Physician referral required for initial PT evaluation reimbursement', 'No prior authorization required for visits 1-6; prior authorization required beginning with visit 7', 'In-network providers only for standard copay; out-of-network 50% after deductible', 'Individual deductible remaining: $400'. Include payer/provider services phone number 1-800-555-0148. Make text visually authentic and clear enough to OCR.

dl-t17.description: Phone photo of an older at-home exercise sheet whose date and exercise content conflict with the current referral restrictions.
canonical_facts: document_type: prior home exercise sheet photo
program_origin: self-directed discharge handout from prior minor ankle injury
listed_exercises: hopping drills, line jumps, interval jogging progression
warning_context: predates current referral and is potentially outdated
dl-t17.generation_prompt: Generate a realistic smartphone photo of a printed home exercise handout lying on a kitchen table, slightly skewed with mild shadows and a corner fold. The handout should look older and informal, titled 'Ankle Return-to-Activity Home Program'. Include patient shorthand 'I. Vale' and date '11/12/2024' near the top. Visible exercise list should include 'single-leg hopping drills', 'line jumps', and 'interval jogging progression'. Add a note saying 'Perform daily if pain < 3/10'. Ensure the date and exercise content are legible because they should visibly conflict with the newer physician referral restrictions. The image should clearly look like a casual photo rather than a scanned document.

dl-t19.description: Photo of Sora Beltran’s passport identity page used to verify exact cross-border traveler identity and document validity.

Make the page visually authentic but fictional, with crisp readable text. Include these exact visible fields: Surname: BELTRAN; Given names: SORA; Nationality: ESPAÑA / SPAIN; Date of birth: 17 AUG 1994; Passport No.: P93846211; Date of issue: 10 MAY 2021; Date of expiry: 09 MAY 2031; Place of birth: BARCELONA. exchange_rule=Strike disruption permits same-day rebooking subject to seat availability

The board should show multiple departures, but make one row clearly readable and central: time 09:20, operator EuroCross Rail, train EC472, destination Lyon Part-Dieu, platform 8, status 'Delayed due to industrial action'.
